analysis.summary: Today's tech and business headlines highlight several significant developments across various sectors. In the realm of cryptocurrency, a Chinese woman was convicted following the seizure of what is considered the largest amount of bitcoin ever recovered (BBC Technology, BBC World). Meanwhile, YouTube agreed to pay $24.5 million to settle a lawsuit related to former U.S. President Trump's role in inciting the Capitol riot (BBC Technology, Ars Technica). The gaming industry saw an unprecedented deal where Electronic Arts was acquired for $55 billion (BBC Technology). In AI advancements, Opera launched its AI-centric Neon browser (TechCrunch), and OpenAI allowed users to make purchases from Etsy within ChatGPT (Engadget). Other notable mentions include regulatory concerns surrounding Firefly Aerospace's rocket program (Ars Technica) and Logitech's addition of haptic feedback to the MX Master 4 mouse (The Verge).
